title: La mesa · a place setting
intro: What is in front of you the moment you sit down. Three of these are worth separating carefully: el vaso is a tumbler for water, la copa is a stemmed wine glass, and la taza is a cup for coffee — English cup covers the last two and Spanish does not. La carta is the menu; el menú often means the set meal of the day.
